title: The MacBook Most People Should Buy Is $200 Off Ahead of Black Friday
gist: Wired deals post: the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) is $200 off at $1,099 on Amazon, its lowest since Apple permanently raised Mac prices in June 2026; the reviewer expects no lower prices before an eventual M6 refresh.

themes.theme: Mac pricing after Apple's June hike

insights.claim: Apple permanently raised prices across its entire Mac lineup in June 2026, and the $1,099 sale price on the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB RAM, 512GB) is the lowest since that hike.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: A lineup-wide Mac price increase points to cost pressure or margin focus at Apple; discounting now relies on retailers.

insights.claim: Amazon frequently sells the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at $1,149, reserving the $1,099 price for major events such as October's Prime Day, versus $1,299 list at Apple and $1,229 at Walmart.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Retailers, not Apple, are absorbing promotional pricing on Macs.

insights.claim: The reviewer expects MacBook Air prices not to fall further over the next few months, with the M6 refresh likely still many months away, while noting prices were lower in the first half of 2026.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Suggests an elongated M5 Air cycle; explicitly not based on insider knowledge.
insights.quote: I don’t claim to have any insider knowledge, but based on pricing history, I can’t see these laptops coming down any lower in price over the next few months.
